mentions.name: Stacktape
mentions.description: An open-source, IaC-first deployment platform for AWS positioned as an alternative to SST, Serverless Framework, and PaaS services like Render.com and Flightcontrol. It deploys to the user's own AWS account with a PaaS-like console UI, auto-generates IaC configuration by scanning the user's code, and includes a built-in EC2 runner claimed to be 2-6x faster than AWS CodeBuild. Its dev mode deploys only the stack parts that cannot be locally emulated (e.g. Lambda functions, Cognito) with fast re-deploys while emulating everything else (containers, SQL databases, Redis, DynamoDB) locally, and it offers an --agent flag optimized for coding agents.
mentions.problem: Deploying to AWS requires mastering complex IaC and AWS configuration, and testing/developing cloud apps is costly with slow feedback loops because parts of the stack cannot be locally emulated.
mentions.audience: Developers deploying and testing applications on AWS, including those working with coding agents.
